build_densecl_neck: build a DenseCLNeck module with specified input hidden and output channels for self-supervised learning
create_densecl_neck_with_grid: create a DenseCLNeck with num_grid to enable adaptive pooling on dense feature maps
run_densecl_neck_forward: run the forward pass of DenseCLNeck on backbone feature maps to get global and dense features
review_densecl_neck_mlp: review the DenseCLNeck MLP branch that uses Linear-ReLU-Linear for global feature extraction
summarize_densecl_neck_mlp2: summarize the DenseCLNeck conv branch that uses Conv-ReLU-Conv for dense feature extraction
